snippet.title: BIRDCAGE - PC Release Date & DEMO Announcement
snippet.description:
The WORLD-EGG has begun its descent!

Our sword action shooting game BIRDCAGE, launches on PC; Tuesday November 18th. Play our new DEMO on Steam, right now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2618150/BIRDCAGE_Dryad_Ecophene_Module_Object/
